title: Post-Market Clinical Investigation Plan- Collagen Dural Regeneration Matrix (DuraMatrix-Onlay Plus)
official: Monitoring the Use of Collagen Dural Regeneration Matrix (DuraMatrix-Onlay Plus) in the Postmarket Phase.
summary: Monitoring the Use of Collagen Dural Regeneration Matrix (DuraMatrix-Onlay Plus) in the Postmarket Phase.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* The general population will be included in the study where a dura substitute is required for the repair of dura mater.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients that have conditions which are contraindicated per the instructions for use (IFU) would be excluded.
